description: Opens an existing ASCII DXF file (AutoCAD R12 to 2018+) in place of the current drawing, so it can be edited with cad_run_commands and saved with cad_export_dxf. Returns counts, what was converted, and a warning listing objects that cannot be read (they would be missing from a saved file).

filePath.description: Path of the .dxf file inside the server folder (CAD_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR, default: the server working directory), e.g. "plans/level1.dxf"

name: cad_open_dxf
